changes: Released Ghost.
3/14 update: Fixed proxy reliability, fixed many bugs, and added a homescreen feature.
3/15 update: Fixed more bugs and improved UX in multiple places.
3/15 update 2: Customization overhaul with more themes and replacement of the CSS editor with Custom Themes.
4/11 update: Full overhaul of features, games, and customization.
95% of the 5000+ games now work; all entertainment options except Ghost Music were working at this point.
Added many settings and improved overall UI/UX.
AI integration improved with Duck.ai and VM performance increased.
4/12 update: Fixed chat source, fixed music source, and fixed multiple connectivity and UI/UX bugs.
Reliability milestone reached with broad feature parity and improved stability.
Small update: Fixed Ghost Music playback.
Published full documentation including Ghost Docs and README updates.
Promoted release track from Beta to Stable for versions 1.4 and onward.
Removed Tor completely to improve reliability and reduce crashes.
Updated WISP server endpoints.
Ghost Music now loads via iframe instead of being proxied.
Codebase cleanup and bug fixes.
Fixed global keyboard shortcuts hijacking and propagation.
Disabled auto-fallback to Ultraviolet for Scramjet.
Reverted default transport back to Libcurl.
Universally fixed global keyboard shortcuts; keystroke interception now works seamlessly across all pages.
Fixed Wisp server fallback routing; added strict blocking on connection failure to completely prevent CORS/IP leaks to local network.
Updated Anime discover source to HiAnime (https://hianime.ms) and implemented a warning popup advising against using the RYU server.
Added customizable Image and GIF Background settings supporting all image types & GIF files.
Added missing ReactBits animated backgrounds and exposed configuration options for existing backgrounds.
Fixed game loading security by removing unnecessary device permissions (camera, microphone) from game iframes.
Added 3 new game sources (Seraph, Truffled, UGS) and cleaned up game names across the catalog.
Updated TV App URL and optimized proxy bypass rules for static game content.
Integrated Monochrome as the default built-in music player.
Fixed many bugs with video entertainment.
Added Ghost Notes, a built-in lecture recorder with microphone capture, live transcription, an offline Whisper fallback for Firefox, and Duck.ai summaries.
Fixed the Quick AI popup closing when you clicked inside it, and added screenshot sharing to Duck.ai.
Fixed the Settings CSS editor doing nothing until the page was reloaded, and wired up the Scramjet and Ultraviolet settings.
Fixed Browser Identity so the user agent, platform, vendor, client hints, and upstream request headers all agree, and stopped disguise mode from falling back to the YouTube TV identity.
Renamed the Quick AI setting and added a Notes toggle to the sidebar editor.
Fixed proxy reliability by retrying the transport, falling back to Epoxy, and recovering stuck pages silently instead of showing a blank frame.
Fixed the wisp server using blocking DNS resolvers, which was breaking sites like Cinejoy. Redeploy the wisp server to get this fix.
Rewrote the documentation, added Notes and Quick AI guides, and expanded the Settings info page.
Refreshed the game catalogs and removed dead and duplicate entries.
Replaced Remote Access with a RayGrid coming soon page.
